statBlock.name: Blue Slaad
statBlock.description: Blue slaadi fight beside red slaadi. Their claw blades carry a curse called chaos phage, and they instinctively avoid killing creatures already bearing a slaad curse.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Mutating Claw attacks.
Mutating Claw. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. A Humanoid hit by the claw makes a DC 15 Constitution save if it carries no slaad curse. On a failure it contracts chaos phage. While cursed, it can't regain HP and loses 10 (3d6) from its HP maximum every 24 hours. A Long Rest doesn't restore the lost maximum.
If the curse reduces the target's HP maximum to 0, the curse ends and the target immediately becomes a Red Slaad. It becomes a Green Slaad instead if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher. The transformation replaces death. Only Wish can undo the transformation.
sections.Slaad control gems:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 285. The Slaad Control Gems sidebar supplies the control gem rules.

statBlock.name: Death Slaad
statBlock.description: Slaad lords infuse gray slaadi with chaotic power to create death slaadi. Death slaadi often direct groups of slaadi that are acting toward a shared goal.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Chaos Blade attacks.
Chaos Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (1d12 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Roll a d4 to determine the condition affecting the target until the start of the slaad's next turn. On 1 it is Charmed, on 2 Frightened, on 3 Poisoned, and on 4 Incapacitated.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the listed spells using Charisma (save DC 16) without Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
1/day each. Blight (level 8), Cloudkill (level 6), Fly, Plane Shift, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Small or Medium Humanoid or return to the slaad's true form. Its size is the only statistic that can change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its usual form.

statBlock.name: Green Slaad
statBlock.description: Green slaadi can arise when a red or blue slaad curses a host capable of casting spells of level 3 or higher. Green slaadi often direct their kin toward portals that gray slaadi scout.

sections.Actions:

sections.Spellcasting:

At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Fireball, Invisibility (self only).

statBlock.name: Red Slaad
statBlock.description: Red slaadi gather in Limbo to wrestle and reshape islands of drifting matter. When one meets a stranger, its mood can turn from play to hunger in moments.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Injecting Claw attacks.
Injecting Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by the claw makes a DC 14 Constitution save if it carries no slaad curse. On a failure it becomes cursed without realizing it, and the claw leaves an egg inside it. Ending the curse destroys the egg.
The egg develops over 2d4 × 10 days. During the last 24 hours the target feels ill, its Speed is halved, and it makes D20 Tests with Disadvantage. When that time ends, a Slaad Tadpole hatches and chews its way out, killing the host.

statBlock.name: Slaad Tadpole
statBlock.description: These ravenous newborn slaadi hatch from eggs implanted by red slaadi. They also appear in Limbo and other realms of chaos.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
sections.Growth: Under most conditions, a tadpole becomes a Blue Slaad within 2d12 hours of hatching. It becomes a Green Slaad instead if its host could cast spells of level 3 or higher.
sections.Slaad control gems:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. statBlock.name: Goristro
statBlock.description: This enormous, minotaur-like demon serves Baphomet and prowls the Endless Maze. Goristros turn their strength against anything that rivals them in size, including giants and fortifications.

sections.Traits:
Demonic Restoration. If the goristro dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor. It immediately regains a body and returns at full HP somewhere in the Abyss.
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Siege Monster. The goristro deals twice its normal damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Brutal Gore attack and two Slam attacks.
Brutal Gore. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 40 (6d10 + 7) Piercing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit by this attack is knocked Prone and pushed up to 20 ft. directly away from the goristro.
Slam. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move up to half the goristro's Speed in a straight line toward a visible enemy.
